sources.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis)
sources.method: HTTP GET per city, daily + hourly variables, timezone Asia/Karachi
sources.citation: Zippenfenig, P. (2023). Open-Meteo.com Weather API. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7970649

sources.name: NASA POWER Daily Point API (MERRA-2 / CERES)
sources.method: HTTP GET per city, community=AG, 10 parameters
sources.licence: No restrictions on use; acknowledgement requested (https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/referencing/)
sources.citation: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project, funded through the NASA Earth Science Division.

personal_identifiers: none (weather values per city and date only)

raw_missing_values_in_period.note: NASA POWER -999 flags and Open-Meteo nulls, counted after merging, before feature engineering

collection_note: Raw API responses were fetched on 2026-11-20 with the exact requests in src/download_data.py (same URLs and parameters, run from a web browser because of a network restriction), cached in data/raw/, then merged by src/download_data.py. Re-running the script reproduces the dataset.
